lines.text_source: A juicy reward goes to whoever kills the Stygian Harpy and drives her foul pack of vultures away from the <color=LOC>Sibuna Desert</color>.
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: Uma generosa recompensa aguarda quem matar a Harpia Estigia e afastar seu fétido bando de abutres do <color=LOC>Deserto de Sibuna</color>.
